<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class DocumentController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Serve document files from the internal document store.
     * Documents are organized by tenant ID and document slug.
     */
    public function show(Request $request, string $tenantId, string $documentSlug)
    {
        // Validate tenant ID format (UUID v4)
        if (!preg_match('/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/', $tenantId)) {
            abort(400, 'Invalid tenant identifier');
        }

        // Build the document path
        $basePath = config('documents.storage_root', '/var/lib/app/documents');
        $documentPath = $basePath . '/' . $tenantId . '/' . $documentSlug;

        // Check file extension is allowed
        $extension = pathinfo($documentSlug, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
        $allowedExtensions = ['pdf', 'docx', 'xlsx', 'txt', 'csv', 'png', 'jpg'];
        
        if (!in_array(strtolower($extension), $allowedExtensions)) {
            abort(403, 'File type not permitted');
        }

        // Verify file exists
        if (!file_exists($documentPath)) {
            abort(404, 'Document not found');
        }

        // Log access for audit trail
        \Log::info('Document accessed', [
            'tenant' => $tenantId,
            'document' => $documentSlug,
            'ip' => $request->ip(),
            'user_agent' => $request->userAgent(),
        ]);

        // Serve the file with appropriate headers
        $mimeType = mime_content_type($documentPath);
        
        return response()->file($documentPath, [
            'Content-Type' => $mimeType,
            'X-Content-Type-Options' => 'nosniff',
            'Cache-Control' => 'private, no-cache',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * List available documents for a tenant.
     */
    public function index(Request $request, string $tenantId)
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/', $tenantId)) {
            abort(400, 'Invalid tenant identifier');
        }

        $basePath = config('documents.storage_root', '/var/lib/app/documents');
        $tenantPath = $basePath . '/' . $tenantId;

        if (!is_dir($tenantPath)) {
            return response()->json(['documents' => []]);
        }

        $files = array_diff(scandir($tenantPath), ['.', '..']);
        $documents = [];

        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $fullPath = $tenantPath . '/' . $file;
            if (is_file($fullPath)) {
                $documents[] = [
                    'name' => $file,
                    'size' => filesize($fullPath),
                    'modified' => filemtime($fullPath),
                ];
            }
        }

        return response()->json(['documents' => $documents]);
    }

    /**
     * Download document with a generated filename.
     */
    public function download(Request $request, string $tenantId, string $documentSlug)
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/', $tenantId)) {
            abort(400, 'Invalid tenant identifier');
        }

        $basePath = config('documents.storage_root', '/var/lib/app/documents');
        $documentPath = $basePath . '/' . $tenantId . '/' . $documentSlug;

        if (!file_exists($documentPath)) {
            abort(404);
        }

        $safeName = Str::slug(pathinfo($documentSlug, PATHINFO_FILENAME)) 
                    . '.' 
                    . pathinfo($documentSlug, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);

        return response()->download($documentPath, $safeName);
    }
}

environment.description: Same Laravel application deployed behind an AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB) with a target group health check on /health. Upstream traffic filtering is handled by a VPC security group (sg-0f9e8d7c6b) attached to the NLB ENIs that restricts inbound on port 443 to three specific CIDR prefixes: 10.200.0.0/16 (corporate VPN egress), 172.20.128.0/20 (partner network peering connection pcx-0abc123), and 198.51.100.64/28 (monitoring probes from Datadog synthetic locations). The NLB preserves client IP via proxy protocol v2 enabled on the target group, and the nginx configuration includes 'real_ip_header proxy_protocol' with 'set_real_ip_from 10.0.0.0/8' to correctly identify source addresses. The EC2 instances sit in a private subnet (no IGW route) with the NLB as the only ingress path. Additionally, VPC Network ACL (acl-0deadbeef) on the NLB subnet has explicit DENY rules for all inbound traffic except the three listed CIDR ranges on port 443, with rule numbers 100-102 for ALLOW and rule 200 as explicit DENY ALL.
